answers.question: Falköping C (`740000060`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly answered. OSM has no platform areas here at all, so nothing can be joined. It does have a 96 m pedestrian underpass (w42605016, layer -1) with stairs, and four entrance nodes on Järnvägsgatan. Jernhusen confirms an accessible entrance from the track side directly into the waiting room. No source found says which platforms the underpass reaches or whether it has lifts or ramps.

open: Platform layout (which tracks share which platform, and how each platform is reached: underpass stairs, lifts, ramps or level crossing): no owner text or plan found. Västtrafik's page gives no PDF, Jernhusen links no plan, and the Swedish Wikipedia page could not be fetched.
Pressbyrån hours: not on Jernhusen's page.
Jernhusen's Falköping and Hallsberg accessibility pages have word-for-word the same text about disabled parking 'vid bussangöringen på Kungsplan'. Check on site which station this belongs to.
